copy.headline: Fort Worth shooting leaves three men hospitalized after fight
copy.caption:
Three men were hospitalized with gunshot wounds on Wednesday morning after a physical fight escalated into a shooting outside a Fort Worth apartment complex. Fort Worth police said it happened around 11:30 a.m. in the 2600 block of Avenue J. According to a preliminary investigation, a man arrived at the apartment complex to meet with a family member.

He encountered another male that he’d had a previous conflict with. Another physical fight broke out between the two men.

story.title: Fort Worth shooting leaves three men hospitalized after fight
story.summary: Three men were hospitalized with gunshot wounds on Wednesday morning after a physical fight escalated into a shooting outside a Fort Worth apartment complex. FORT WORTH, Texas - Three people were shot outside an apartment complex in Fort Worth on Wednesday morning. Fort Worth police said it happened around 11:30 a.m. in the 2600 block of Avenue J. According to a preliminary investigation, a man arrived at the apartment complex to meet with a family member. He encountered another male that he’d had a previous conflict with. Another physical fight broke out between the two men. The second man pulled out a gun and shot the first man. The first man’s family member intervened and shot the second man. The second man returned fire and shot the family member. All three men were taken to the hospital with gunshot wounds. There’s no word yet on how seriously the three men were injured. Police…
